text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being directly programmed. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model. This model finds patterns and uses them to make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, a model can learn from emails that are marked as spam or not spam. Later, it can predict whether a new email is spam. The accuracy of these predictions depends on the quality and amount of training data.
